description: Angular component for battery level widget settings in Thingsboard UI, managing form controls, layout options, and data bindings.

classes.name: BatteryLevelWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for configuring battery level widget settings, including layout, colors, and display options.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes form controls with provided widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current settings.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string of the widget's value using current configuration.
